projects.title: Mapping across ground & air.
projects.summary: A personal project combining drone and rover data for 3D mapping. Currently in development.
projects.problem: Build a mapping system that brings together ground and aerial perspectives.
projects.decisions: Exploring SLAM and sensor fusion to connect data from a drone and a rover.
projects.development: Developing the ground-and-air mapping system as a personal project.

projects.title: Three degrees of play.
projects.summary: A tabletop game with a three-degree-of-freedom opponent: X, Y, and rotation, moving through randomized patterns.
projects.problem: Build a mechanism with at least 2.5 degrees of freedom. Our team turned the assignment into a tabletop game: a human player competes against a moving mechanism to score through goal cutouts.
projects.decisions: We chose three degrees of freedom: translation in X and Y, plus rotation. Randomized motion makes the opponent less predictable. The player can flick the puck, as in carrom, or use a mallet, as in air hockey.
projects.development: Designed the mechanism and its components in CAD, then built a working game. The component models show our exported geometry, while the video shows the assembled mechanism in play.
projects.results: Completed a playable prototype with translation and rotation. The demonstration documents the game in use.
projects.technical: Motion: X translation, Y translation, and rotation. The interactive viewer uses the supplied STL exports; each file can be inspected independently.

gallery.caption: The completed ENG ME 360 game in play.

projects.title: Better localization through SLAM.
projects.summary: Research into localization accuracy and efficiency through sensor fusion and SLAM optimization.
projects.problem: Explore how sensor fusion and algorithm optimization can improve simultaneous localization and mapping for robotic navigation.
projects.decisions: Focused the research on sensor fusion and optimization to address localization accuracy and efficiency. Specific algorithm comparisons will be documented alongside the paper.
projects.development: Conducted individual research into applications of SLAM for robotics, UAVs, and autonomous navigation.
projects.results: Produced research on improving localization precision. The paper, experimental methods, and quantitative comparisons will be added to this case study.
